questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Saint Lucia?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Geography” part of the Saint Lucia article.

questions.proof: The capital city of Saint Lucia is Castries.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Saint Lucia?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Saint Lucia article.
